from.place: The natural tensor comparison for continuous cocontinuous module restriction

title: The natural tensor comparison for continuous cocontinuous module restriction
statement: Let (C,J) and (D,K) be small sites in the same universe, F:C→D continuous and cocontinuous, R a sheaf of commutative rings on D, and V restriction of R-module sheaves to the restricted ring on C. For all M,N there is a specified isomorphism theta(M,N):V(M tensor N)≅VM tensor VN, constructed from the presheaf tensor restriction map and the canonical sheafification comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-slice-module-sheafification, lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-tensor]. For morphisms f:M→Mprime and g:N→Nprime it satisfies V(f tensor g)≫theta(Mprime,Nprime).hom = theta(M,N).hom≫(Vf tensor Vg).

source.place: Tags 03CY, 03DH and 04IX; tensor/sheafification and continuous restriction.

proof.text: Use the inverse presheaf tensor structure map, which is an isomorphism for continuous presheaf restriction. Compare the underlying restricted module sheaves with the restricted underlying presheaves using restriction of scalars along the identity.

Compose restriction of the tensor/sheafification isomorphism, the continuous cocontinuous sheafification comparison, the presheaf tensor comparison and its two underlying comparisons, and the inverse target tensor/sheafification isomorphism.

Compose the naturality squares using compose_four_squares, inverse_square, tensorObjIsoSheafification_natural and tensor_square, whose existing proved public declarations now live in this module after retirement of the duplicated open-restriction module. The sheafification tensor square follows from the two whiskering identities, the tensor square from tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, and the remaining square lemmas from associativity and inverse cancellation. No open-localized tensor comparison is used in the general slice proof.

theorem sliceTensorIso_natural
    {M M' N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} A} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    letI := monoidalCategory R
    let := monoidalCategory (R')
    (sliceCommModuleRestriction (J := J) F R).map (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫
        (sliceTensorIso (J := J) F R M' N').hom =
      (sliceTensorIso (J := J) F R M N).hom ≫
        ((sliceCommModuleRestriction (J := J) F R).map f ⊗ₘ
          (sliceCommModuleRestriction (J := J) F R).map g)
